note: Measured on a fresh seeded database (seed 42) at collection time.

criteria.criterion: Platform manages and tracks all assets in the supplied dataset
Ingests data from at least three simulated finding sources
criteria.evidence: 5 sources: container, cspm, identity, pentest, scanner

criteria.criterion: Duplicate findings are automatically identified and correlated
criteria.evidence: 714 duplicate rows merged (28.6%); 500 findings corroborated by more than one source

criteria.criterion: Risk scoring uses technical severity and business context
criteria.evidence: 2588 of 3454 open findings have a risk band different from their scanner severity
901 open findings carry threat-intel points; removing KEV/exploitation signals would lower the band of 444
100.0% of 393 tasks match the dataset owner; routing engine 100.0%

criteria.criterion: SLA breaches are automatically identified and escalated
criteria.evidence: 3 overdue tasks; 3 without an approved exception, 3 escalated (run the scheduler to escalate new breaches)

criteria.criterion: Exception workflow operates end-to-end with audit evidence
Attack path view shows how exposure chains change priority
criteria.evidence: 555 findings sit on modeled paths; 300 were raised a risk band; average +9.67 points

criteria.criterion: Dashboards provide operational and executive views
criteria.evidence: Role dashboards: executive, analyst, manager, auditor; heatmap, trend, MTTR, SLA, forecast and executive report endpoints

criteria.criterion: APIs support external / simulated ticketing integration
criteria.evidence: 0 tickets created; Jira/ServiceNow simulators and HMAC webhook (not configured)

criteria.criterion: Measurable reduction in manual triage/reporting effort
